objective: Beat Jev 1.13 on the fixed 11-suite composite with a simple decision agent returning calibrated probabilities
stop: Research continues until explicit user stop; no GPU launches beyond reservation
data_exclusion: Entire 11 benchmark task datasets excluded from train/dev/calibration, including unsampled examples
calibration: Fit scalar temperature on independent nonbenchmark calibration data
priority: E4 frozen Qwen3.8-27B with E3 v3 dataset and Medium head recipe
preferences: data quality and selection before architectural complexity
approximately <=10 minutes per experiment excluding setup
log W&B train/dev and calibrated benchmark composite/per-suite collapse
save hypotheses, decisions, code/config/seeds/results externally; checksum tensor exports
evaluation: Fixed observed benchmark panel is iterative feedback, not an untouched holdout
branch_policy: Use separate autoresearch/* branches; preserve unrelated work.
scientific_method: Preregister hypothesis, mechanism, predicted slices and acceptance criteria before execution
Change one factor at a time when feasible; disclose confounded comparisons
Pin data/model/code/dependencies and seeds; preserve exact reproduction commands
Run meaningful correctness checks before GPU launches
Retain failures and negative results; separate exploratory evidence from confirmation
Verify promising gains across seeds before robust superiority claims
requested_ablations: After E4, test removing the causal attention mask in a controlled comparison; retain padding masks, re-extract features, record any unchanged causal recurrent paths.

crash_loop_policy.prevent: CPU import/behavior checks before GPU launch; no blind retries; application retries remain zero
crash_loop_policy.detect: Local watcher checks only registered research apps every 20 seconds with bounded CLI timeouts
crash_loop_policy.stop: Stop whole experiment app on first container-startup failure or repeated traceback; preserve artifacts and failure evidence
crash_loop_policy.recover: Diagnose, patch, validate, then one explicit relaunch on a new attempt ID

required_change_record.hypothesis: What can improve, why, and supporting evidence
required_change_record.targeted_change: The exact intervention and comparison; explicitly list fixed factors
required_change_record.success_criterion: A measurable pre-result decision rule, including comparator, metric and practical threshold
required_change_record.afterward: Measured result, keep/reject/inconclusive, limitations, next test; runtime fixes must also state verification criterion

checkpoint_selection.tie_break: earlier epoch; do not use NLL to break accuracy ties
checkpoint_selection.calibration: Fit global temperature separately on the calibration split after checkpoint selection
checkpoint_selection.authority: Explicit user correction: no use accuracy, 2026-10-15 UTC
checkpoint_selection.history: Prior NLL-selected checkpoints retained as historical artifacts; future runs and queued replacements use accuracy.
